title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Future Uncertain
items.text: LIV Golf CEO Scott O’Neil declined to guarantee the league’s last four 2026 events will be played amid reports PIF may pull funding and O’Neil seeks $300–$350 million from new investors.

items.headline: Rocket Companies Ends PGA Deal
items.text: Rocket Companies is ending its 13-year sponsorship of the Rocket Classic after this summer’s event due to concerns over the PGA Tour’s new Track 1/Track 2 event split and sponsorship costs, leaving the Tour to find a new Detroit-area sponsor.
